description.value: The Steveston Railway Museum is a heritage attraction in the historic fishing village of Steveston, Richmond, BC — a popular destination for cyclists riding the dyke trails along the Fraser River delta. The OSM record links to the Steveston Historical Society, which has been preserving and promoting Steveston's history since 1976 and coordinates a network of heritage sites in the village. Steveston's compact, walkable village core, waterfront, and cannery sites make it a natural stop on any cycling tour of Metro Vancouver's south arm.
